g.id: System Context diagram for Compute Cost & Risk Monitor (2026-10-15)
GPU buyer [Person] Sizes a GPU workload and its budget.
Compute Cost & Risk Monitor [Software system] Turns Azure's GPU list prices into workload costs and what-if price moves.
Azure Retail Prices API [External system] Microsoft's published list prices; no account needed.
Anthropic Claude API [External system] Paid AI model, called by hand on invented prices only.
Sizes workload costs and budget exposure [web browser]
Asks for the market brief's text [HTTPS, JSON]
